_comment: The screens of the design prototype under /mockups/, the paths between them, the intent each realises, and the three UX variants. Read at runtime by components/proto-base; checked by tests/build/test_mockups.py (every edge names a screen, every intent id exists in review/intent/).

variants.name: Desk
variants.description: The password manager's shape the brief draws: a header with the environment and the lock, a sidebar, a list, forms. Mouse first.

variants.name: Focus
variants.description: One thing per screen: a single card in the middle, big targets, a bottom bar of four tabs, every step explained in a line. Phone first.

variants.name: Command
variants.description: Keyboard first: a command bar at the top (type add, open 2, lock, env dev), a dense table, an inspector on the right, a status line. Terminal people.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.purpose: The first screen. The environment badge is always visible; prod is neutral, anything else coloured. After sign-in the app routes to setup when there is no keyring and to unlock when there is.

screens.title: First run: create a passkey
screens.purpose: One passkey, one keyring, one recovery code shown once. Nothing decrypted is ever written to storage.

screens.title: Unlock
screens.purpose: Touch the passkey; the PRF output derives the wrapping key; the keyring opens in memory. The recovery code is the other way in.

screens.title: The vault: the list
screens.purpose: Search, filter by kind, add, open. Kinds are a closed list and each has its own colour, so a vault key never looks like a password.

screens.title: One entry
screens.purpose: Reveal, copy, edit, delete. A vault key is guarded: it says what it opens and asks before it leaves.

screens.title: Devices: passkeys and the recovery code
screens.purpose: Every passkey that can open the keyring, with its last use; add one from this device; regenerate the recovery code.

screens.title: Environment
screens.purpose: Pick a built-in environment or enter a custom one, export it, import it, reset. Changing it signs you out.

screens.title: Account
screens.purpose: Who you are, how you signed in, the keyring's size against its soft limit, sign out, delete the account.

screens.title: Admin: the setup checklist
screens.purpose: Every per-project resource as a row with a check and, where it can be fixed from the browser, a Fix button.

screens.title: Tests: the compatibility matrix
screens.purpose: Every probe page run in this browser, one row each: WebAuthn PRF, crypto, config, auth, storage, keyring round trip, offline, leak check.

edges.label: keyring created, recovery code written down
a new device unlocks the other way
every probe green: try the app
